data.one_liner: Progress bars with curved edges and customizable animation durations.
data.what_it_does: Provides circular and linear progress indicators featuring curved edges and optional build animation duration. It allows developers to specify values, stroke widths, background colors, and primary colors.
use_when: You need circular or linear progress indicators with curved edges.
You want to animate the progress indicator's entry over a specific duration.
avoid_when: You need complex data visualization charts or gauges.
You require non-standard progress shapes outside of linear and circular.
strengths: Supports both linear and circular progress indicators.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic curved progress indicators.
data.minimal_example:
CurvedCircularProgressIndicator(
  value: 0.5,
  strokeWidth: 12,
  animationDuration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  backgroundColor: Color(0xFFFFFFCD),
  color: Colors.blue,
)
